stop: Stop after the stage-2 exploratory evaluations (cal/test/H3/H4, H4b, het_cal/het_test/H1/H2), the confirmatory rows (conf_test 40-3039, conf_H4, conf_H4b, conf_het_test, conf_H1, conf_H2) and the T2 evaluation of st-n6-1.
_doc: Role models, review round 0 fix 5. PREREQUISITES: (1) cfcap-models-b1 outputs pulled to ~/.cache/vast-out; then `$PY scripts/models_export.py ~/.cache/vast-out/<b1 dirs> --stage-weights $CFCAP_OUT/compute/stage2/models-b1-weights` (manifest + weights.pt per grid entry, ~4 MB each). (2) For models-t2 only: stress's T2 simulate outputs at $CFCAP_OUT/compute/stage2/b1-t2eps, and $CFCAP_OUT/compute/stage2/models-t2-pred = weights.pt of st-n6-1 + calib.json (results/models/calib/calib_st-n6-1.json written by models_export from the models-eval2 cal rows; T1 cal only). models-eval2: task cfcap/models/eval2.py:TASK regenerates the generator episodes by (plate, split, index) (same eids as gen-ref2 shards and the baselines' rows), runs the 6 n6 models (st x3 seeds, bb, ds, stl) with batch-1 synchronised timing per episode (sec_direct), and for st-n6-1 the compositional route for every candidate of every episode (sec_comp = posterior + rollouts, end to end per decision). The export then writes dec_models.csv.gz (seconds = end-to-end), latency_models.csv (end_to_end = 1) and the calib JSONs. Matched-compute SMC and capxfer on the same eids are the baselines role's (cfcap-b1 smc groups). unit_s ESTIMATES: 50 episodes per unit, ~10 s generation, 6 x 5 ms direct, ~1.0 s/episode composition (20 candidates x S 16 x 10 legs = 3.2k leg trials at the generator's 3.8k leg-trials/s) -> ~65 s (H4 ~3x); 100 units -> 10 shards x 10 units x 90 s mean. models-t2: 4000 T2 test episodes x ~1.2 s (direct + composition of self/children; merges refused: only the parent's T2 observation exists). EXTENSION (plan §2b/§2c, docs/CONFIRMATORY.md): models-eval2-scale = st/bb n6 on H4b (11-16 modules); models-eval2-het = the het models (cfcap-models-het) on het_cal (their cal), het_test, H1, H2, with the compositional route also run type-blind (bq* columns); models-conf-main-scale and models-conf-het = the confirmatory rows (C-MAIN conf_test 40-3039, C-SCALE conf_H4 0-1499 / conf_H4b 0-1399, C-HET conf_het_test / conf_H1 / conf_H2 0-999), --reserve-shard0 so shard 0 (excluded by the scorer) holds no rows. The weights input (models-b1-weights) must also contain the cfcap-models-het runs (models_export.py --stage-weights on both pulls). Confirmatory labels are computed on the box but never opened before 2026-11-26 01:45Z: models_export.py and models_scaling.py drop conf_* splits, and `models_export.py --confirmatory` (writes results/models/confirmatory/dec_conf_models.csv.gz: §5a columns + claim, shard, parent_n, variant, lower_marg; T1-cal rows with status exploratory) refuses to run before then. scripts/models_scaling.py writes results/models/paper/scaling.csv (coverage / certified fraction / unsafe vs N = 1..16 with episode-bootstrap CIs) from test, H4, H4b. EMIT RULE: emit at cfcap >= 1591e17 (generator OMNI_MU 0.2; H1 / H2 / conf_het labels must match the generator's shards) - i.e. plain `make_jobs.py emit` from current HEAD after staging the weights; never with --cfcap-ref older than 1591e17. models_het (a8b81a0) is unaffected (mecanum + conventional only).
